I haven't run this sequence through the level checker. I traced it by hand, and it depends on my column counts for the island's edge rows 20–24, which I couldn't verify exactly.

**Why a long bridge is needed.** The west door (27,17) sits on an island across 14+ cells of water, and the mirror's reflections are the only way over it. Every reflection of this single east-facing mirror moves a thing diagonally, so x−y never changes. The west island only accepts x−y between 8 and 12, so a hero has to hop along the x−y = 12 diagonal.

**The relay chain.** The hops use four stepping-stone crystals and these mirror positions:

| Hop | Mirror at | Thing moves from → to |
|---|---|---|
| A1 | (44,25) | (44,32) → (37,25), stone S1 |
| A2 | (48,25) | (37,25) → (48,36), stone R |
| A3 | (48,21) | (48,36) → (33,21), stone Q |
| A4 | (52,21) | (33,21) → (52,40), stone P |
| A5 | (52,16) | (52,40) → (28,16), on the west island |

**Plan.**
1. Move the mirror to (44,25) and feed the four crystals one at a time to (44,32).
2. Relay each crystal along the chain so they sink as S1, R, Q and P in that order. Later crystals ride over the earlier stones.
3. Shuttle the mirror back to A1 and send trader #1 through all five hops.
4. Trader #7 does all the mirror pushing and finishes on the east door (53,17).
5. Trader #1 steps from (28,16) to (27,16), then onto the door at (27,17).

Before each `X`, the pushing trader steps out of the mirror's lines of sight so only the intended thing is reflected.
